verdict.rationale: The evidence shows macOS ships some built-in apps out of the box: Reminders, Messages and Music (macos-docs-28), the Phone app (macos-docs-22), the Passwords app (macos-docs-35), plus Safari and Shortcuts (macos-docs-33, macos-docs-19). None of the specific utilities named in the story are documented, so support is only glancing. Missing for 10: evidence of built-in Calendar, Weather, Maps, and Clock apps, and independent or hands-on corroboration of these utilities' quality for switchers.
